_: The texts the legal review relies on. tools/statutes.js fetches each one once a week, from the e-Gov law API and from GitHub's site-policy repository, and compares it with the value recorded here. A value is recorded by hand, after the operator has read the change.

text.missing: the article or item was not found
text.title: law title
text.issueTitle: Weekly check: a statute or a term that the legal review relies on may have changed
text.issueHead: The weekly check on {when} found these different from the recorded values.
text.issueFoot: Read the changed text, check docs/legal-review.md and the policies, then record the new value in verification/statutes.json.
text.closed: The check on {when} found everything as recorded. Closing.
